Frequently Asked
Questions
What is Spring Health, and how do I know if my insurance covers this service?

Spring Health offers therapy and medication management through a diverse network of licensed mental health providers. We’re in-network with many health plans, but our providers also offer self-pay if you’re not covered. You can book appointments directly through Spring Health. Or, if you have access to Spring Health through your employer, you can activate that membership here.

What mental health services are covered, and what conditions can be treated?

Spring Health provides therapy, psychiatric medication management, and scheduled mental health check-ins for a variety of mental health concerns, including:


Anxiety
Depression 
Trauma 
ADHD 
Eating disorders 
Addictions 
Stress
And more

‍

Between sessions, we also offer on-demand mental health tools for quick relief and expert-backed resources like our Neurodiversity hub.

Is my care confidential?

Yes. Your care with Spring Health is private and protected. We follow strict confidentiality standards, including HIPAA compliance, to safeguard your personal health information. While we do not share individual therapy session details, certain information, such as billing or program engagement data, may be shared with your insurance provider as part of standard health plan processes.

How soon can I get an appointment, and can I choose between in-person and virtual care?

Most members can book an appointment to see a therapist within 24 to 48 hours—no more long waitlists or referrals. Both virtual and in-person sessions may be available, depending on your location.

How much will I pay per session? Will the price ever change?

With in-network coverage, your therapy and medication management appointments are billed as in-network claims, meaning your health plan’s standard deductibles, cost-shares, and copayments apply. If you’re not covered or don't want to use your insurance, no problem. Our providers also accept out-of-pocket payments. 

‍

How do we know Spring Health's outcomes will hold up when we recommend it to a client?

Consultants have access to their own view in Spring Insights, so you can evaluate Spring Health for yourself and stand behind the numbers you bring to a client.
